home.title: Ramza Portfolio Rebalancing Calculator
home.description: Calculate buy and sell share quantities from target portfolio weights with Ramza.
home.introHeading: Buy and sell shares aligned to your target allocation
introBody: With Ramza, enter your stock and ETF target allocation to see whole-share buys and sells plus remaining cash.
Split new capital with simple buy mode, or rebalance existing holdings with an additional contribution—all in one place.

shell.lead: Enter a purchase budget or your holdings with target weights to get buy and sell quantities plus a cash sleeve. Use simple buy allocation or full portfolio rebalancing in one place.

basic.title: Simple buy rebalancing
basic.description: Split a purchase budget by target weights into share quantities.

portfolio.title: Portfolio-based rebalancing
portfolio.description: Match target weights using holdings and new cash—including sells when needed.
